svg.text: Boundaries proposed from four takes. Every one is editable — the
hip under target → “lift your hips a little higher”
hold too short → “hold it at the top, two seconds”
symmetry over → “even up — you are favouring the right”
Cue text is data, not code. No model runs in the per-frame path, so what is written here is exactly
WHY THIS EXERCISE · SHOWN TO THE PATIENT
Bridging builds the back of the hip without putting your knee through any range at all —
which is why it is here while the knee settles.
Each threshold needs a fixture proving it
